div.head: I Cn 14.1
div.ab: And freolsa ⁊ fæstena healde mon rihtlice.
And freolsa ⁊ fæstena healde mon rihtlice.
And freolsa and fæstena healde mon rihtlice.
Und Feiertage und Fasten halte man gesetzmässig.
And let feasts and fasts be kept lawfully.
And festivals and fasts shall be duly observed.
And feasts and fasts are to be properly observed.
